summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all task requirements (glob patterns, label assignment, priority resolution, config validation, CLI interface, workflow structure, E2E through act). Well-organized across 6 test modules with logical separation of concerns. Excellent use of fixtures, helper functions, and test isolation. Exact output matching in CLI tests and multi-layer testing (unit→integration→E2E) provide strong regression detection. Minor gaps: edge cases like unicode/extreme inputs not tested, temp file cleanup incomplete in cli.test.ts, some boundary conditions (file deduplication, infinite/NaN priorities) untested. Workflow dependency on act availability is acceptable given task requirements.
